_readme: Where the key is. The stash is an object standing on a bush - there is no chest sprite
and there does not need to be one: an object is an interaction POINT, and what the
player sees is the decor tile that was already on the map.
It carries once:true, so the memory of having opened it lives in GameState.seen and
survives a save. Keyed by map and id, so the keep could have its own 'stash' without
